FaZe Clan is an American professional esports and entertainment organization founded in May 2010. They are the first international team to win a Global Offensive Major, doing so at PGL Major Antwerp 2022.

[edit]
See also: History of FaZe Clan

  • January 20th - FaZe Clan acquire the roster of G2 Esports consisting of Maikelele, rain, fox, jkaem, and aizy for a reported amount of $700,000. [1][2]
  • February 9th - FaZe Clan sign RobbaN as the team's coach. [3]

  • April 10th - FaZe Clan acquire kioShiMa from Team EnVyUs. [5]
  • August 16th - FaZe Clan acquire allu from ENCE eSports to replace fox, who is benched. [6]
  • October 19th - FaZe Clan acquire karrigan from Astralis to replace kioShiMa, who is benched. [7]
  • November 9th - FaZe Clan promote kioShiMa to the starting lineup to replace jkaem, who is benched. [8]
  • December 22nd - FaZe Clan part ways with jkaem. [9]

  • February 3rd - kioShiMa is acquired by Team EnVyUs. [15]

  • December 16th - FaZe Clan bench karrigan. [22]

  • January 5th - RobbaN transitions to a managerial role at FaZe Clan. [24]

  • March 14th - karrigan is acquired by mousesports. [27]
  • May 13th - FaZe Clan part ways with AdreN and sign NEO on trial. [28][29]

  • August 10th - Bymas is acquired by mousesports. [36]
  • August 11th - FaZe Clan sign Kjaerbye. [37]
  • October 28th - NiKo is acquired by G2 Esports and FaZe Clan part ways with YNk while olofmeister returns to the starting lineup as a stand-in. [38][39][40]

  • February 15th - FaZe Clan sign karrigan. [44]
  • March 13th - RobbaN resumes coaching FaZe Clan after transitioning back into the role following the expiration of his ESIC ban. [45]
  • April 2nd - FaZe Clan sign innersh1ne as analyst. [46]
  • June 1st - FaZe Clan bench coldzera. [47]
  • June 14th - FaZe Clan reinstate olofmeister to the starting lineup. [48]
  • September 9th - coldzera is acquired by Complexity Gaming as a stand-in on free transfer. [49][50]

  • July 27th - FaZe Clan sign NEO as an interim coach. [54]

  • September 20th - FaZe Clan acquire Twistzz from Team Liquid. [67]
  • September 25th - EliGE is acquired by Team Liquid. [68]

  • June 25th - FaZe Clan bench broky and acquire JBOEN on loan from BIG Academy until the end of the season as his replacement. [75][76]

[edit]
